hints.content:
We expand the parentheses using the **distributive property**:

$\blueD A(B+C)=\blueD A\cdot B+\blueD A\cdot C$

We can also think about the problem using an area model:

[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Two rectangles of different sizes make up a larger rectangle. At the left, a rectangle has the width of negative four t cubed and a length of negative t. At the rectangle on the right, it has a width of eight t squared with a length of negative t.

hints.content:
Here's how the solution goes, algebraically:

$\begin{align}
&\phantom{=}\goldE{-t}(-4t^3+8t^2)
\\\\
&=\goldE{-t}(-4t^3)+(\goldE{-t})(8t^2)
\\\\
&=4t^4-8t^3
\end{align}$

Here's how the solution looks in terms of the area model:

[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Two rectangles of different sizes make up a larger rectangle. At the left, a rectangle has the width of negative four t cubed and a length of negative t. Inside of this rectangle is four t to the fourth power. At the rectangle on the right, it has a width of eight t squared with a length of negative t. Inside of this rectangle is negative eight t cubed.

question.content:
